name: Comment
formulaDescription: The sample is compliant as soon as the operator has filled the comment.

name: Dimension
formulaDescription: The dimension measured on the sample must stay within the nominal dimension of the control plan line, minus the min tolerance and plus the max tolerance.

name: Label presence
formulaDescription: When the control plan line requires a label, the sample is compliant only if the label is present. When no label is required, the sample is always compliant.

name: External condition
formulaDescription: The external condition observed on the sample must be the one accepted on the control plan line, among: brand new, good condition, scratched, damaged.
